g.text: run() in src/harness.ts repeats this until the finish gate lets the run end. The order of the checks is the order in the code.
argfix: repair a broken call, check its arguments
loop: the same call a 3rd time? refused
PreToolUse hook: may block or rewrite
permissions: floor, deny, taint, ask, allow, mode
approval: you, or the approval reviewer
run: reads together (up to 5), writes one by one
result: condense, ledger, mask secrets, PostToolUse
reread: local models check each requirement
ledger: the record backs the summary?
coverage, audit: unread files, unused modules
advisor (when set): one look before finishing
